title: Evidence Transport And Read-Only Verification Hardening
summary: A correctness milestone: retrieval optimization cannot strengthen a claim, discard its supporting metadata, or introduce implicit writes.
identityScope: Version and generator identify this contract's historical baseline. Current source and reader identities are declared in shin-development-v1.json and lexical-retrieval-v1.json; the invariants below remain applicable.
scope: Canonical-record-only Pack deduplication; every match remains bound to the full transported record and exact verification range.
Explicit lifecycle metadata with independent path/type authority ranking; incidental prose does not infer supersession, rejection or acceptance.
Numbered ADR files use any nonempty numeric prefix followed by a hyphen inside a decisions directory, not a hardcoded digit count.
One bounded physical snapshot layout check for freshness and verified-snapshot reads.
Existing-only read locks; optional freshness cache is prepared by explicit publication, never repaired by retrieval.
Hermes validates the expected Core result schema and preserves structured errors without accepting malformed success.
Entrypoint documentation references the canonical version instead of maintaining competing release declarations.
compatibility: Generator-v16 publications must be rebuilt explicitly. No compatibility reader or implicit migration is added. Consumer profile ids, roots, index keys and runtime contracts do not change.
invariants: Same text does not imply the same evidence record or lifecycle.
Coverage means transported retrieval support, not truth or product authority.
Lifecycle status, repository authority, evidence kind and verification level remain separate.
No read-only command creates or repairs index, lock or cache files.
Missing or malformed cache state causes read-only hash verification, not trust escalation.
An existing incomplete publication fails closed; live source scanning requires explicit --source-scan in that case.
No automatic command execution, consumer-specific rule or automatic compaction hook.

required: Neutral authority and Pack provenance regressions, including negative controls against the prior binary.
Read-only filesystem identity and fast/exact/verified snapshot rejection agreement.
Hermes malformed envelopes and structured Core diagnostics.
Portable Release and sanitizer tests, clang-tidy and relocated installation.
ARM64 and AMD64 execution plus unchanged performance budgets on available real corpora.
